name: Keycloakify Frontend Redirect Env
objective: Harden login/info redirects to use ASTRO_APP_URL in local dev with safe fallbacks, localized paths, configurable timeout, and aligned documentation.
exit_criteria: Local register and info timeout redirects resolve to ASTRO_APP_URL when provided.
Production fallback public behavior remains unchanged when no local override is provided.
README and detailed AsciiDoc documentation explain configuration and validation flow.
